entry.short: Two terms for the miles from a player's hometown to each school: log distance and inside 150 miles.
body: Hometown from the recruiting history (ranked recruits: 27% of moves). No hometown on file: both terms are 0 for every school.
Fit 2022-24 moves, held 2025-26 moves with a hometown (n 371):
log loss of the chosen school 5.395 -> 5.244 (t 4.56 by origin team), top-10 hit 12.1% -> 21.8%. All moves: top-10 12.6% -> 15.1%.
A school within 150 miles of home: coefficient +.52; log miles -.35.

entry.short: Men's basketball expenses from the Equity in Athletics survey enter the pay model.
body: ln(men's basketball expenses), z-scored inside the academic year, newest year ending before the season.
Leave one school out, 746 pay rows at 79 public schools: RMSE of ln pay .336 -> .280, R2 .50 -> .65 (t 3.95 by school).
Kept drivers: spending, tenure, high-major, program level.
The survey covers private schools, so their value estimate reads a measured budget.

entry.short: On Selection Sunday the committee model is stacked with the Bracket Matrix's final consensus.
body: Seed line = a + b x model line + c x matrix average seed
at-large score = a + b x model logit + c x share of brackets naming the team.
Fit 2015-19, held 2021-26. Seeds (408 teams): log loss 1.257 -> 1.007 (t -3.08 by season, 5 of 6), exact line 51% -> 68%.
Used only when the regular season is over and no bracket is out. Earlier dates are logged daily and scored once after the season.

entry.short: A birth-year-only player gets the mean birth day for his class, not Oct 15.
body: k = first D-I season - birth year - (class - 1).
Mean day of year by k from 16,744 day-precise careers: k 19 Apr 30, k 20 Jul 24, k 21+ Aug 22.
Held out on 942 board players who entered 2023 or later:
mean absolute age error .347 yr (Oct 15) and .258 (Jul 1) -> .237 (t 15.6 and 5.8).
FIBA youth rosters on file add a day-precise date when the birth year agrees with Barttorvik's:
1,401 of 1,427 checked dates within 3 days.

entry.short: The contract length, in years, a player would sign for as a free agent now.
body: Same inputs and signings as xAAV (3,242 CapWages deals 2010-26), linear in years, clipped 1-8.
Held out a signing year at a time: mean miss .83 years vs 1.00 by position x age (t -13.0, 16/17 years)
Surplus = (xAAV - cap hit) x seasons left on the current deal.

entry.short: 3Y WAR = the chance he plays in the next three seasons x his WAR if he does.
body: Stay chance: logistic on pWAR pace, age, age squared, ln TOI per 82 and share of team games played.
WAR if he plays: the 3Y form refit on players who stayed.
Leave one season out 2010-23: skaters RMSE 2.455 -> 2.447 (t -6.9 by season, 14 of 14), goalies 4.074 -> 4.066 (t -3.0, 10 of 14).
Kept at every season share .1 to 1.
IN 3Y column (skaters): chance he plays in season S+3; held-out error under 3 points in every tenth.
Goalies fail that check (up to 10 points) and get no column.
NBA: 3Y XPM = stay x XPM given he plays + (1 - stay) x -2. Numbers under 1Y / 3Y XPM.
entry.where: NHL value board (3Y, IN 3Y); NBA VORX/XPM leaders (3Y)

entry.short: Goal rates shift by .35 per km the venue sits above the visitor's home ground, past the first 1,000 m.
body: Gap = max(0, venue - visitor home - 1,000 m) less the same for the home side, in km.
Elevations: SRTM 90 m at the venue city; a nation's home elevation = median of its home venues since 1990.
Tuned 2000-15 (c .35 from 0 to .5). Held 2016 to Jul 2026, 9,734 matches, 464 with a gap:
log loss t -2.59 by match day with frozen rates, -3.51 in the model (.85529 -> .85402); 10 of 11 years
Holm p .020 over four sports.
Failed in CFB (held t +1.02) and CBB (held t -0.49, tune wrong sign). MLS not run.

entry.short: How often the outcome landed inside the printed 80% range, on seasons scored after the range was set.
body: CBB FV range: 91.1% (n 1199, boards 2013-16), too wide: the floor at 20 sits inside most ranges.
A conformal correction leaves it at 91.0%.
NBA 3Y (shrunk target) conformal band by projection group: 80.3% overall, 75.9% at proj 2+, 83.6% at 0-2.
NHL 3Y skaters conformal band: 77.9% overall, 75.7% at pWAR .5-2.
Tolerance was 3 points in every group of 100+: none passed, so no range on the site changed.
CFB FV, NFL 3Y and rank ranges not scored (rows not rebuildable here).

entry.short: MD: points per 100 matchup possessions a defender's assignments scored against everyone. PAOE: what they scored against him minus MD, shrunk by poss / (poss + 300).
body: Source rows: one defender on one offensive player in one game (NBA.com box score matchups via shufinskiy/nba_data)
partial possessions and points. Each assignment's season rate is pulled toward the league by 100 possessions.
Defenders with 1,000+ partial possessions. Odd/even game reliability of PAOE at 1,000+ possessions: r .82 (2017-18 to 2025-26).
As a prior-season team-defence input PAOE did not help (team net RMSE 3.528 vs 3.525, held 2023-26 t +0.13): display only.

entry.short: League goal difference a match above the game model's pre-match expectation, by manager.
body: Residual = actual 90-minute GD minus the walk-forward model's expected GD; shrunk with 40 average matches
100+ matches, 2012-13 to 2025-26 (Transfermarkt managers).
As a term in a manager's first 10 matches at a new club: held 2023-26 t -0.05 (failed).

entry.short: A second attack/defence pair from shots on target, blended into the national-team match model.
body: Target = shots on target x running goals a shot on target (about .3); same update as goals.
Goal means move by .15 x (shots gap - goals gap) in logs once both sides have 5 matches with ESPN stats (12 competitions
Held 2016 to Jul 2026 on 5,191 matches where it applies: 1X2 log loss .8699 -> .8680, t -4.18, 9/11 years.

entry.short: Chance of each final set score (2-0, 2-1, ... 0-3) for a tennis match, from the match chance.
body: Each set is won with one per-match logit x + tau x e:
e is a standard normal drawn once a match, so a player who is better on the day stays better across sets.
x is solved so the set scores add back to the model's match chance exactly; tau = 1.1, fit on 2012-22 tour main draws.
Held out 2023 to Nov 10 2026 (n 20,336): exact set-score log loss 1.2870 with independent sets
1.2668 with tau (t -11.3 by tournament, 4 of 4 seasons).
Shown under each match card's win bar. Model numbers only; no market line.

entry.short: Chance of each award: a voter model on simulated rests of the season, blended with Polymarket where a liquid market is open.
body: Model: 3,000 simulated rests of the season, each finish scored by a voter model fit on past ballots.
Blend: model^.05 x market^.95, renormalised. 7 held 2025-26 races, winner log loss: model 2.32, market 1.12, blend 1.13 (t -2.3).
Blended only when the event has 3+ two-sided quotes, prices summing within 25% of 1 and $50,000 traded. Otherwise model only.
The cell hover keeps the model number; the weekly ledger scores the model alone against the market.
Conviction view: P(lead) = share of simulations in which he leads the award's pool on this season's value alone.
Games left run at this season's own rate: no last season, no shrunk or predictive rate, no voter model, no market.
NFL and CFB: SVAR by position (no SV: OL, K, P; CFB defence). NBA VORX, D-XPM for DPOY; NHL WAR, GSAx for Vezina; CBB BPM.
Soccer: SVAR (GAR rebuilt from this season alone: one-season xG plus-minus, finishing and keeper saves at face value).
entry.where: Awards tabs (predictive awards, conviction awards): NBA, NFL, NHL, CFB, CBB, soccer

entry.short: A game's rate minus what that opponent allowed in its other games, shrunk.
body: adjusted = value - exposure x D[opponent]. D = the opponent's allowed rate in its other games minus the league's,
shrunk toward 0 by n / (n + K). Kept only where the odd / even game split-half r of a season rises
(paired bootstrap P >= .90 on held seasons) and the first part of a season predicts the rest no worse.
NBA lineups and on/off (held 2025-26): fives r .13 to .17, trios .35 to .41, pairs .50 to .55, on-off .22 to .24.
Soccer GAR inputs (held 2022-26): on-pitch xG for .65 to .70, against .45 to .54, buildup .64 to .65.
College basketball lineups and on/off (2025-26, 6,247 games): the opponent is its season offence and defence rating,
schedule counted, with a home term. Odd / even r: fives .18 to .25, pairs .48 to .64, on court .54 to .69, on-off .08 to .12.
First half to second half with ratings solved apart on each side: pairs r .41 to .44 (t -6.3), on court .46 to .50 (t -4.4).
Failed: NHL goalie GSAx against opposing finishing (P .18 to .60), NHL lines, pairs and on-ice xG (P .02 to .77),
NBA box value (+.003, too small to move a rank).
Adjusted at the source already: XPM, college BPM, tennis SPW+ / RPW+, CS2 and 1NT RWA, team units, every game model.
Weather, tested Nov 20 2026 (airport hourly observations nearest the venue), none used:
soccer, 24,926 matches 2013-26: wet +2% goals, cold -0.7% per F under 40, wind -0.3% per mph over 10; walk-forward totals
deviance t +.1 to -1.5, xG totals worse. Tennis, 1,125 outdoor events: +.37 serve points won and +.50 aces per 100
per 10 F inside an event (held 2020-26 t -2.7), .04% of the error and no match dates or forecast feed.
entry.where: NBA and college basketball lineups, on/off, lineup leaders; soccer GAR

entry.short: The next seven days' best games across every sport, 0-100.
body: W = 100 x (.30 Q + .20 C + .20 S + .20 L + .10 T) + bonus, cap 100. Display only, no backtest.
Q quality: each side 1 - (rank - .5) / min(N, 60) in the sport's rating order, 0 past 60; mean of the two.
C closeness: 1 - (P home - P away)^2, percentile among the sport's games. T total: projected points or goals, percentile.
S stars: each side's top three players by the sport's value (NFL WAR, NBA VORX, NHL WAR, soccer GAR, college FV - 20)
x chance to play (injury tags: out / IR 0, doubtful .25, questionable / day-to-day .6; the game model's play chances first),
weighted 1 / .7 / .5, scored by rank in the sport's teams like Q.
L leverage: a target's swing from one result, dP = phi(Phi^-1(p)) / sqrt(n / 4 + 1 / 2), p = the season sims' odds,
n = games left; playoff 1, division / bye / top four .5, soccer title and relegation 1; side L = min(1, sum / .35);
game L = .6 x higher side + .4 x lower; postseason games 1. Tennis and CS2: round and format levels.
Bonus: named rivalry 6, division or conference game 2, both ranked 4, one ranked 1. Top 15, at most 4 a sport.
A listed game that starts moves to "scores" with its W frozen and its live / final score (ESPN scoreboard; tennis and CS2 from the site's files); it drops 24 hours after the final.
Source: scripts/watch_games.py -> data/watch.json, every half hour.

entry.short: Transfer value in USD: prize money a player adds over replacement for two seasons, priced on reported buyouts; team value sums the five.
body: Player: prize money he adds over a replacement-level player in a five of four average tier-1 starters, for two seasons
(aging curve, 15% a year discount), x A, the dollars a team pays per prize dollar added. Team value = the current five summed.
Prize curve: a roster's prize money over the next 182 days on its five's mean RWA vs the tier-1 starter mean (VRS top 20),
Poisson, rating + rating squared, Valve's VRS prize ledger (every snapshot's top-ten winnings, Feb 2024 on).
Held out from Jul 2025: deviance explained 0.79 vs VRS points 0.76; both together 0.81 (rosters only, players can't carry VRS points).
A and the replacement level (tier-1 mean - q SDs) fit on 5 reported buyouts (insider/press, unconfirmed): A 1.66, q 4.
Leave one fee out: x1.50 typical miss vs x2.44 for a flat price per player; replacement fixed at the VRS 51-100 starters x1.64.
Reported fees sit near flat ($1.1M-2.5M) and three are Falcons deals, so values are compressed and at that buyer's prices.
Eternal Fire to Aurora (reported under $2.5M for five) prices at $7.1M: a miss. Contracts are not public and not modelled.
Signed = the same value at the first map of the player's current stint (bo3.gg); stints from before Jul 2024 start there.
entry.where: Counter-Strike transfer values, team values, signings

Held-only, so it fails the gate; registered for one score after 2026-27.
NHL win model against MoneyPuck's pregame number and the close, same lined games with a pregame-dated MoneyPuck file (log loss
Stacking MoneyPuck on the model does not help (2024-26 n 3,684: .66825 -> .66844, t +.5), so it is not used.

NBA minutes in a team's first 10 games add preseason starts (share of the last two preseason games started
fading to 0 by game 11): games 1-10 held 2024-26 minutes MAE 4.714 -> 4.676 (t -3.48, 3/3 seasons).
Pre-draft meetings: +3.0 log-pick units for a top-30 visit or private workout with the team, +1.75 for another meeting.
Real picks 1-100, 2024-26: top-1 hits 5.7% -> 11.7%; weight picked on two drafts, scored on the third +4.0 points (t 2.5).
Off until the 2027 meetings page exists (winter).
Polymarket (global) venue: tour-level main draws, 6 to 24 hours out, model 4+ points over the mid, mid between 25% and 75%.
Price = ask + fee (.03 x p x (1 - p)). Tune Oct 2025-Apr 2026: 164 picks, close value +4.2 points (t 3.5).
Held May-Nov 10 2026: 404 picks, close value +2.2 points after costs (t 4.5), realised +8.3% (t 1.3). Paper stakes.
xXPM = ridge E[NBA XPM over his NBA minutes, next 3 seasons | plays], weighted by those minutes (lambda 300).
xVORX counts 0 for a season out of the NBA (75% of G League seasons): it sits near 0 for most; xXPM is the rate alone.
xXPM held out vs no G League stats: minute-weighted RMSE 1.44 vs 1.60 (t -3.6, 11/15 seasons, Holm), bias .01.
pSV/60: SV per 60 plays over three seasons weighted 1, .7, .5, shrunk to the QB mean with 650 plays.
Next season wMSE .0258 raw to .0159 (t -11.7, 10 of 10 seasons 2016-25).
1Y P20/P80: held out projection residuals in five bands of season share; left out seasons hit .200 and .800 (3Y .201, .800).
aGAR/90 (first seasons) = GAR/90 less .0032 a year of age over 21. Ranks the next two seasons better than GAR/90: .664 vs .654, t -2.66.
SV: season WAR, calendar year to date, every level, same per match credit as WAR.
Split half r .81 ATP, .82 WTA (2015 to 2025); next season r .85 ATP, .84 WTA.

body: Shrunk per-90 rates (on-pitch xG for and against, on-off, npxG, xGBuildup, keeper saves) plus xG plus-minus (offence, defence)
weighted to next-season team goal difference.
On-pitch xG and xGBuildup are opponent and home adjusted: minus what that club allowed in its other matches, shrunk,
and the league's home / away gap. Odd vs even matches of a player-season, held 2022-26: on-pitch xG for r .65 to .70,
against .45 to .54, buildup .64 to .65. Own npxG and xA gain .003 to .006 and stay raw.
xG plus-minus: weighted ridge over 3 seasons of on-pitch spells (same 22 on the field)
a spell's npxG a 90 on the attacking side's players (offence) and the defending side's (defence), league-season and home terms
offence shrunk toward his xG + xA a 90 over the window, defence toward 0.
Replacement per position = regulars (900+ minutes) on the bottom three sides by goal difference of each finished league-season
pooled. League strength counts. Held out R2 .686 (.673 before plus-minus; nested test t -2.97, 9/11 seasons).
PAR = GAR x points per goal of difference (.626).
Ridge on log Transfermarkt value: GAR now and past two seasons, minutes, age, position, league, club
national-team matchday squads in the last 12 and 24 months, last season's Champions League + Europa League minutes
last season's goals over xG and assists over xA.
Held out R2 .73 (Oct) to .80 (Jul). Gap to TM forecasts TM's next move (slope .26 Oct
12/12 seasons) and the summer fee over TM (corr .22, 1,850 sales 2015-22).
